blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Emilio Aguinaldo College may have kept its NCAA Season 102 campaign alive, but coach Jerson Cabiltes and the Generals are bracing for a tough response from defending champion San Beda. Following EAC’s 75-64 win over the Red Lions in Game 2 on Thursday that forced a decider, Cabiltes stressed the need to stay prepared and guard against complacency, expecting San Beda to make the necessary adjustments.
